fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat (1988 Smoker Craft Magnum 161 aluminum fishing boat) with motors and trailer.
findings: Painted aluminum hull sides look a bit dull and flat rather than glossy, especially the tan lower section on the port side
Light grime and faint streaking on the hull paint near the bow
Some yellowing and light soiling on the cream vinyl seats
Light dust and lint on the blue carpet in the bow deck and around the helm
Scattered items left in the bow area (plastic bag, loose wiring) clutter the interior photos
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Smoker Craft Magnum 161. It looks well kept, but the hull paint has gone a little flat and the cream seats show some yellowing. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a hull buff and wax plus carpet and vinyl cleaning, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
